turns.message: Here is my long ride from last Saturday. What does it show?
turns.reply:
Normalized power of 212 W came in above average power of 188 W, a gap of 24 W (212 minus 188). That spread usually means the power output wasn't steady, it varied enough over the ride (climbs, surges, terrain changes) that NP pulled higher than the simple average. I can't say what caused it specifically since the image doesn't show a power graph or route profile, just the summary numbers.

Avg HR of 148 bpm against a max of 171 bpm is the other data point here, but without your threshold or zones on file I can't tell you what effort level that represents.
